reaction: The contrast between adjacent hot lava and solid rock made the setting vivid.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following dissolved volatiles through bubbles and volcanic plumes into an atmosphere was satisfying and clarified that outgassing releases existing material rather than creating hydrogen.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive cooling and crust-building steps felt somewhat repetitive, especially when each offered only one combination.

surprise.text: The cracked crust gave later water pathways into the rock, linking present convection to a future process.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though several coast-building steps were guided by the only offered combination rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how rain interacts with the contrasting lava and crust, though I hope the next chapter offers more meaningful choices.
